ISC2 Candidate
description: ISC2 Candidates are individuals pursuing or considering a cybersecurity certification. To become a Candidate, the individual must apply online and provide minimum identifying information, as well as affirm that they will abide by the ISC2 Code of Ethics and Privacy Policy.
skills: ISC2 Candidates are part of the diverse, global community of individuals with a desire to create a safe and secure cyber world.

ISC2 Candidates are part of the ISC2 pledge to certify one million individuals and as such, have access to foundational education materials to pursue the entry-level Certified in Cybersecurity certification.
ISC2 Candidates are pursuing their first ISC2 certification, or gaining the foundational knowledge necessary to join the cybersecurity workforce.

title: Operating Systems: Overview, Administration, and Security

image.alt: Operating Systems: Overview, Administration, and Security badge

description: This badge earner understands the key cybersecurity concepts related to operating systems. They have a basic understanding of architecture, file systems, security features, and user accounts in Windows, macOS, and Linux. They can use command-line tools to perform basic administrative tasks. The badge earner is also familiar with virtualization as it relates to operating systems and cloud computing.

title: Cybersecurity Architecture V2
description: This badge earner has demonstrated foundational to advanced cybersecurity knowledge, including the CIA triad, IAM, endpoints, and network, application, and data security. Through hands-on labs, they have applied MFA, identified threats, responded to incidents, and developed strategies to improve organizational security.

title: Introduction to Packet Tracer
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge has knowledge and skills to create digital models of IP Networks and IoT Systems using Cisco Packet Tracer.

title: CompTIA Security+ ce Certification
description: Earners of the CompTIA Security+ certification have the knowledge and skills necessary to perform core security functions required of any cybersecurity role. CompTIA Security+ professionals know how to identify and address potential threats, attacks and vulnerabilities and they have established techniques in risk management, risk mitigation, threat management and intrusion detection.

title: Data Science Orientation
description: This badge earner has a good understanding of why data science, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning are revolutionizing the way people do business and research around the world. They have general knowledge on what data science is today.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Cybersecurity course. The holder of this student-level credential has introductory knowledge of cybersecurity, including the global implications of cyber threats on industries, and why cybersecurity is a growing profession. They understand vulnerabilities and threat detection and defense. They also have insight into opportunities available with pursuing cybersecurity certifications.

title: Database Essentials and Vulnerabilities
description: This badge earner understands the concepts of relational and non-relational databases and can implement various data protection techniques to secure sensitive information. They know how to configure and manage database user profiles, password policies, privileges, and roles. They can identify, analyze, and mitigate database injection vulnerabilities, including OS command and SQL injection. The badge earner can also design and implement comprehensive database and application auditing models.

title: AI Skills Fest 2026
description: Earners demonstrate foundational and applied AI knowledge, including how to use AI tools to enhance productivity, create content, and solve real-world problems. They can identify practical use cases, apply AI responsibly, and continue building skills through guided learning pathways.

title: API Security Fundamentals '25 (2 hours)
description: The API Security Fundamentals course covers the core threats to APIs and challenges to prevent breach. The course includes modules on real-world API breaches, the OWASP API Security Top 10, the 3 Pillars of API Security (governance, testing and monitoring), and the application security technology landscape. The course provides strategic advice for developing secure API programs, and includes specific best practices for security and development teams.
